You are an independent bounded checker for a planning task. Do NOT approve any deployment, source, budget change, or procurement. Work only from the data below. Your finding will be reported separately as an unverified independent opinion, not accepted truth.

Context: Three-site PM2.5 observation study. The working uncertainty target is at most ±3 µg/m³. Site conditions: S1 indoor 35–65% RH, 12–26 °C; S2 waterside outdoor 80–95% RH, 10–22 °C; S3 forest-edge 70–90% RH, 9–23 °C. Existing lab data (sources/lab-samples.csv) are all in µg/m³:
L01 Echo RH40 20C ref10 measured11.1
L02 Echo RH45 21C ref15 measured14.2
L03 Echo RH50 21C ref20 measured21.2
L04 Echo RH60 22C ref25 measured25.7
L05 Reference RH45 20C ref10 measured10.4
L06 Reference RH90 20C ref20 measured20.6
L07 Reference RH95 18C ref30 measured29.1
L08 Reference RH75 22C ref15 measured15.8

New external candidate field-validation data (inbox, not accepted): the note explicitly says reference_mg_m3 is in mg/m³ and measured_ug_m3 is in µg/m³. CSV:
F01 Echo 45C? (humidity 45) temp20 ref_mg_m3 0.015 measured_ug_m3 16.0
F02 Echo RH60 22C ref 0.025 measured 26.2
F03 Echo RH85 19C ref 0.015 measured 24.0
F04 Echo RH90 18C ref 0.025 measured 36.0
F05 Echo RH95 18C ref 0.030 measured 42.0
F06 Reference RH85 19C ref 0.015 measured 15.6
F07 Reference RH90 18C ref 0.025 measured 25.8
F08 Reference RH95 18C ref 0.030 measured 29.2

The field note also says: the sample is only to check for obvious systematic bias at high humidity, not to prove long-term statistical performance across the full range; the field team has NOT provided a validated Echo humidity-correction function, and has NOT approved replacing actual calibration with a linear guess.

Tasks (bounded):
1. State the correct conversion from mg/m³ to µg/m³ and recompute the reference value and deviation (measured − reference) for every F01–F08 in µg/m³. Show the table.
2. Quantify the high-humidity performance of Echo versus Reference (e.g., absolute and relative deviations at 85–95% RH), and compare with the ±3 µg/m³ target.
3. State whether this new candidate data, on its own, is sufficient to (a) accept Echo for S2/S3, (b) accept the ±3 target as demonstrated across the site envelopes, or (c) justify a targeted verification. Explain sample-size/replicate/coverage limits.
4. Flag any unit or double-counting trap a careless reader could fall into.
5. Give a one-paragraph bottom line, explicitly labelled as an independent unverified opinion.

Keep the response under ~600 words, with the numeric table. Do not claim acceptance or approval.
